add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Creates the device with no program yet — use "Add a program" next to give it one (or several).

add_program.title: Add a program
add_program.description: Pick the device and name the new program (e.g. "Eco coton"). The next screen asks for its phases.

add_program_phases.title: Program phases
add_program_phases.description: One phase per line, format `<minutes>min@<watts>W`, e.g. `20min@150W`. At least one phase is required.

edit_program.title: Edit a program
edit_program.description: Pick which device's program to edit.

edit_program_phases.title: Program phases
edit_program_phases.description: One phase per line, format `<minutes>min@<watts>W`, e.g. `20min@150W`. This replaces the whole list of phases.

abort.no_programs: No device has a program to edit yet.
abort.no_removable_programs: No device has more than one program to remove.

error.duplicate_program: This device already has a program with that name.
